compiled_state.title: acli-integration: verify-after-create uses JQL search on newly-created issue -> fails due to Jira index lag
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 2. Incident Overview

**What happened**: acli-integration.py create_issue() creates a Jira issue successfully (DIG-4172 assigned), then immediately calls get_issue(jira_key) to verify. get_issue uses JQL search (key = DIG-4172) which fails because Jira Cloud's JQL index has eventual consistency — the newly-created issue is not yet searchable. The verify step raises RuntimeError("Issue DIG-4172 not found") and the exception propagates up, killing the entire reconciler pass.

**Expected behavior**: verify-after-create should tolerate Jira index lag by either (a) retrying the JQL search with backoff, or (b) using the REST API GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key} directly which is immediately consistent.

**Actual behavior**: Single JQL search attempt fails on index lag, raises RuntimeError, crashes reconcile_once.

**Evidence**: GHA run 26538875194 — "ERROR: reconcile_once raised: Issue DIG-4172 not found" after "Warning: assignee 'Test' cannot be assigned — retrying without assignee"

**code_version:** ea45206914

**Affected file**: plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py lines 308-311 (_verify_created_issue) and lines 674-686 (get_issue)
